style: Warm hand-painted children's picture-book illustration in gouache with a little coloured pencil, soft paper grain, rounded friendly shapes, rich but gentle colours (saffron yellow, turquoise, pomegranate red, leaf green, warm cream, dusty pink), soft daylight, lively expressive faces, plenty of small charming details. Setting: a cosy Iranian-inspired town and countryside (blue-tiled doorways, a courtyard with a little pool and potted geraniums, pomegranate and mulberry trees, rolling golden hills). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs with writing or speech bubbles anywhere. Nothing frightening or violent. Original characters only: not in the style of any living illustrator, no famous characters or logos.

images.prompt: A character sheet on a plain warm-cream background: the five characters standing side by side in a row, full body, facing the viewer, evenly spaced, each clearly separate, friendly poses. The recurring cast, always drawn the same way: AVA, a 9-year-old girl with shoulder-length dark wavy hair held by a mustard-yellow hairband, round red glasses, a teal pinafore dress over a white T-shirt, jeans and red sneakers, often holding a small notebook; NIMA, her 6-year-old brother, curly black hair, big round eyes, an orange-and-white striped T-shirt, green shorts and a toy magnifying glass; KIAN, their 12-year-old neighbour, tall and lanky, short neat black hair, a cobalt-blue hoodie and a backpack, a confident grin; GRANDMA MEHRI, a kind round-faced grandmother with silver hair under a loosely worn floral scarf, a long plum-coloured cardigan and reading glasses on a chain; and HUDHUD, a small friendly hoopoe bird with a tall orange-pink crest tipped in black, black-and-white striped wings, a long thin curved beak and big bright eyes.

A character sheet on a plain warm-cream background: the five story animals standing side by side in a row, full body, facing the viewer, evenly spaced, each clearly separate. The story's animals, always drawn the same way: MOTHER GOAT, a white nanny goat with soft brown patches, kind eyes and a small blue headscarf knotted under her chin; her three kids: SHANGUL, a white kid with a red bell collar; MANGUL, a light-brown kid with a green bell collar; and LITTLE GRAPE, the smallest, cream-coloured, with a purple bell collar and a brave little face; and the WOLF, a scruffy grey cartoon wolf who is more silly and sneaky than scary, with a long nose, droopy ears and a too-wide sheepish grin (no sharp teeth showing).
